# Proverbs 21 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 21:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | To-do righteousness and-justice is-chosen by-YHWH more-than sacrifice. |
| LOGOS | To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice. |
| PNEUMA | Doing what's right and fair matters more to the LORD than any religious ritual. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 21:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | [The]-plans-of [the]-diligent [lead] only to-abundance, but-everyone [who is]-hasty — only to-lack. |
| LOGOS | The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty. |
| PNEUMA | Careful planning by hard workers leads to plenty, but rushing leads to poverty. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | [The]-violence-of [the]-wicked drags-them-away, for they-refuse to-do justice. |
| LOGOS | The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, because they refuse to do what is just. |
| PNEUMA | The violence of the wicked drags them down, because they refuse to do what's right. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 21:10 (overlap: 0%)

| LOGOS | The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
